study: KV-admitted sub-42-GPU continuation of cluster42, separate from frozen V3 protocol
kv_admission: Reserve prompt tokens plus public 1000 output-token maximum on every resident layer of every visited GPU; hold prompt at source until a full route is available; FIFO; retry on query completion
candidate_generation: memory_plan.memory_shortlist, deterministic static score across 2/3/4 branches; active GPU count <42; at least 3047 KV tokens per resident layer

smoke.purpose: Select one feasible layout; not used as the final claim

formal.baseline: Helix 42-GPU MaxFlow under identical fixed-window trace
formal.decision: Pass only if, on each paired seed, candidate throughput >= Helix, P95 TTFT <= Helix, and P95 TPOT <= Helix, with all windows successful and identical trace_sha256
formal.failures: Preserve every failed window; a failure does not count as passing

smoke_selection_record: At 180 s, w3_b1 used 22 GPUs and exceeded Helix throughput while lowering both P95 latencies. w2_b8 had worse TTFT; w4_b4 had worse TTFT despite greater throughput. Selection made before formal outcomes.
